test_cases.name: empty_input_asks_symptom_and_repro
assertions: Asks what is broken: error message, failing test, or unexpected behavior, plus exact repro steps
Does NOT start investigating without a symptom

test_cases.name: invokes_systematic_debugging_no_fix_first
assertions: Invokes superpowers:systematic-debugging with the symptom as input
Completes Phase 1 root cause investigation before proposing any fix
Does NOT edit code before Phase 1 completes

test_cases.name: checks_api_layer_first
test_cases.input: /debug web app báo Network Error khi gọi /api/skills
assertions: Checks whether anything listens on :8000 before touching code
Checks whether the API answers directly, bypassing the vite proxy

test_cases.name: hotfix_writes_record
test_cases.input: /debug production checkout 500 từ alert, đã tìm ra lỗi null
assertions: Record contains Symptom, Root cause, Regression test with red then green output, Fix, and Verify

test_cases.name: contract_change_stops_to_intent
test_cases.input: /debug production lỗi, fix cần đổi auth contract
assertions: Stops and suggests /intent for the architecture lane
Does NOT apply the auth change as a hotfix

test_cases.name: three_failed_fixes_question_architecture
test_cases.input: /debug đã thử 3 fix đều thất bại
assertions: Questions the architecture per the skill

test_cases.name: report_and_next_command
test_cases.input: /debug (đã fix một bug thường, không phải production)
assertions: Reports root cause, the single fix applied, and verify output
Does NOT write a hotfix record
